subject: prd/abandoned-feature-retirement
statement: When cleanup completes, the system shall prove that every protected historical record and every unrelated E2E test in the pre-cleanup inventory retains its exact path, mode, bytes, and digest, and that the unchanged unrelated E2E inventory passes on the cleanup candidate.
rationale: Containment includes source integrity and behavior, not mere test presence.
fit_criterion: Pilot inventory reports zero protected or unrelated-test identity changes and the exact pre-cleanup unrelated E2E set passes on the candidate and fresh clone.
